user.title: Enable Banking
user.description:
Connect a bank account via the Enable Banking Open Banking (PSD2) API. You need an application registered at https://enablebanking.com/cp/applications with your own account whitelisted ("restricted production app" — free for personal use).

Register this exact URL as a redirect URL for your application, otherwise the bank cannot send you back here:

`{redirect_uri}`

data.private_key: Private key (PEM content, not a file path)
data.aspsp_name: Bank name (as listed by GET /aspsps, e.g. "C24")
data.valid_days: Consent validity in days (max. per bank, usually 180)

reauth_confirm.title: Renew your bank consent
reauth_confirm.description:
The consent for {aspsp} needs a fresh login. PSD2 requires strong customer authentication at least every 180 days — there is no way around it.

Submit to be taken to your bank. Select the same accounts as before, otherwise entities for missing accounts will stop updating.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Enable Banking API. Check application ID, private key and bank name/country.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed — application ID or private key is not accepted by the API.
error.bank_error: Your bank aborted the authorisation with "{error}" and gave no further detail. This is usually temporary — try again, and if it persists, try a different authentication method (app push, SMS or chip TAN) at the bank's login page.
error.no_code: The bank redirected back without an authorisation code.
error.no_accounts: No accounts were linked in this session. Make sure you selected at least one account during the bank login.

abort.already_configured: This application/bank combination is already configured.
abort.reauth_successful: Re-authorisation was successful. Your consent has been renewed.
abort.no_external_url: Home Assistant has no external URL configured, so your bank cannot redirect back here. Set one under Settings → System → Network → Home Assistant URL and start again.

consent_expiring.title: Bank consent for {title} expires in {days} days
consent_expiring.description:
PSD2 consents last at most 180 days and cannot be refreshed automatically — a new login at your bank is required. Once it lapses, balances and transactions stop updating.

Go to Settings → Devices & services → Enable Banking and re-authorise the entry.
